findings: ## What will not work on iPhone (blunt) - WebXR `immersive-ar` is "Not supported" in Safari on iOS through 27.2; Chrome for Android 154 is "Partial support" (https://caniuse.com/webxr). Google states WebXR AR runs on Chrome for Android via ARCore (https://developers.google.com/ar/develop/webxr). Any "AR overlay with our own HUD" is Android-only. - iPhone AR is AR Quick Look only: a USDZ file, iOS 12+, launched by ``, served as `model/vnd.usdz+zip`, feature-detected with `relList.supports("ar")` (https://webkit.org/blog/8421/viewing-augmented-reality-assets-in-safari-for-ios/). It is Apple's viewer, so no custom UI on top. - Camera needs HTTPS: `getUserMedia()` works only in secure contexts; on HTTP `navigator.mediaDevices` is undefined (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MediaDevices/getUserMedia). - `speechSynthesis` is supported on iOS 7+ (https://caniuse.com/speech-synthesis). Speech recognition is only "Partial" on iOS 14.5+ (https://caniuse.com/speech-recognition); a caniuse mirror notes Siri must be enabled and it is unavailable in home-screen web apps (https://docs.w3cub.com/browser_support_tables/speech-recognition). Use text input plus TTS on iPhone. - Fullscreen API is "Partial" on iOS 12+ (https://caniuse.com/fullscreen) and there is no WebXR VR, so "VR mode" on iPhone can only be a panorama viewer. `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` requires a user tap (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DeviceOrientationEvent/requestPermission_static), listed from iOS 14.5 (https://caniuse.com/mdn-api_deviceorientationevent_requestpermission_static). ## Recommended stack (web-first) **3D and AR: `` 4.4.0** (https://registry.npmjs.org/@google/model-viewer/latest), CDN `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@google/model-viewer@4.4.0/dist/model-viewer.min.js`. Default `ar-modes="webxr scene-viewer quick-look"`; adding `quick-look` without `ios-src` "will generate a USDZ on the fly"; `canActivateAR` detects support (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/master/packages/modelviewer.dev/data/docs.json). Scene Viewer needs Android 7.0+, an ARCore device, Google app, GLB input, and a `browser_fallback_url`; no deprecation notice (https://developers.google.com/ar/develop/scene-viewer). **Time-travel slider:** `img-comparison-slider` 8.0.7, MIT, under 12 kB, `slot="first"/"second"` (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/img-comparison-slider@8.0.7/README.md) between today's photo and a Higgsfield reconstruction. 3D variant if time allows: three.js `renderer.localClippingEnabled = true` plus `material.clippingPlanes` (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/dev/examples/webgl_clipping.html) or `setScissor` views (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/dev/examples/webgl_multiple_views.html); drei `` uses gl.scissor for the same in R3F (https://drei.docs.pmnd.rs/portals/view). **Guide: Claude API** via `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, which supports Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge; browser use is disabled by default (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/main/README.md). Call it from a Pages Function or Vercel Function, model `claude-opus-5-5`, `client.messages.stream`. No vector database: put the curated Sharjah corpus in `system` with `cache_control: {type:"ephemeral"}`; minimum cacheable prefix is 512 tokens on Opus 5.5, cache reads 0.05x (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching.md). TTS: Web Speech first; ElevenLabs Free gives 10,000 credits, about 10 minutes, no commercial license (https://elevenlabs.io/pricing), `POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}` with `xi-api-key` (https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert). **Map:** MapLibre with OpenFreeMap: no keys, no request limits, commercial use allowed, no SLA (https://openfreemap.org/). Routing: OSRM demo `/route/v1/{profile}/{lon,lat;lon,lat}?overview=full&geometries=geojson` (https://project-osrm.org/docs/v5.24.0/api/), now under FOSSGIS terms, "One request per second max" (https://routing.openstreetmap.de/about.html). Fallback: Mapbox Directions, 100,000 requests and 50,000 web map loads free monthly (https://www.mapbox.com/pricing). **Deploy:** Cloudflare Pages Free: 500 builds/month, 20,000 files, 25 MiB per asset (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/platform/limits/index.md); Functions bill against Workers Free, 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/index.md); previews are `https://.pages.dev` (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/preview-deployments/index.md). Vercel Hobby: 12 functions per deployment (https://vercel.com/docs/functions/runtimes), 300 s max duration (https://vercel.com/docs/limits), 100 GB and 1,000,000 invocations, non-commercial only (https://vercel.com/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines), automatic Let's Encrypt certificates (https://vercel.com/docs/domains/working-with-ssl). **Higgsfield CLI:** `higgsfield generate create nano_banana_2 --prompt "..." --wait` for images; `kling3_0 --start-image ./first.png --duration 5 --mode pro` for image-to-video; `seedance_2_5 --mode t2v` for text-to-video; `--json`, `higgsfield model list` (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/higgsfield-ai/cli/main/README.md). ## Verified assets (download needs a free Sketchfab login; glTF is auto-generated) - Dhow: "Low Poly Ancient Dhow Ship", CC BY 4.0, 1.6k triangles (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/low-poly-ancient-dhow-ship-f25b4552dce24d379833160dd217db84); "Dhow01" CC BY, 92k faces (https://sketchfab.com/models/44cd10977ae646268d87f850ff321186). - Sharjah heritage, all CC BY-NC by Global Digital Heritage: "Khor Fakkan Portuguese Fort", 187.3k triangles (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/khor-fakkan-portuguese-fort-sharjah-uae-4cc18b0663cd4626a6e88614d8a0f147); "Excavation of the Al Midfa Mosque", 2.1M faces (https://www.sketchfab.com/3d-models/excavation-of-the-al-midfa-mosque-sharjah-47ce73cf844c464585906ec4b7b7fdc9); "East Fort at Fili", 2.4M faces (https://sketchfab.com/models/85eeb6d1e6084ee1856b4d3b04892d30); "Pre-Islamic bronze eagle, Mleiha", 97k (https://sketchfab.com/models/048576620b8743a2a2cd40a48b45e143). NC is fine for the hackathon with credit, not for a startup. - Islamic architecture, CC BY: "Mosque Low Poly" 8k (https://sketchfab.com/models/b0ca82895c484acfa8e172b3881a2fb9); "Arabic mosque" 6.1k (https://sketchfab.com/models/e04f80ea13a94f879e7a26b1628e1a21); "Hall of Ambassadors, Alcázar of Seville" 68k (https://sketchfab.com/models/c5c4347421444f66b15129b028d2cc7a); "Nurulla Minaret" 61k (https://sketchfab.com/models/e68284ae9a3c4a0fb87887e260fd9bd9). - Props, CC BY: "Low Poly Camel" 4.2k (https://sketchfab.com/models/e2571167e3d846e59769b61913f1de64); "Ornate Islamic Arabian lantern lamp Hanging" 80k (https://sketchfab.com/models/4936156b05734b09bc3b0404c1ce8fd9); "Oasis Trading Post" 492k (https://sketchfab.com/models/09f6ee9fa51b4331a950c15720b24759); "Low-Poly Arabic House" CC BY-SA 35k (https://sketchfab.com/models/133c8e55597949beabbec37fb06d4dd7). - Not found: zero downloadable results for "falaj", "qanat", "badgir", "wind tower barjeel" (https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/search?type=models&q=falaj&downloadable=true); Poly Pizza has no dhow (https://poly.pizza/search/dhow). Fake the falaj with a three.js box channel or a Higgsfield image. - Shrink the 2M-face scans with `gltf-transform optimize in.glb out.glb --compress draco --texture-compress webp` (https://gltf-transform.dev/cli). ## Tracking fallbacks (ranked) 1. MindAR 1.2.5, MIT, image and face tracking, targets compiled at https://hiukim.github.io/mind-ar-js-doc/tools/compile (https://registry.npmjs.org/mind-ar/latest). Its docs state no browser matrix; iOS Safari support is forum-reported only (https://discourse.threejs.org/t/how-to-make-ar-app-that-can-run-on-ios-devices-too/68978.md). Test on the real iPhone in the first 30 minutes. 2. AR.js location-based needs GPS, accelerometer and magnetometer; "sensors may be miscalibrated, resulting in an incorrect North" (https://ar-js-org.github.io/AR.js-Docs/location-based/). Demo risk; fake with the map. 3. 8th Wall: "All paid subscriptions ended on February 28, 2026 when the hosted platform was retired"; engine binary is free, no account (https://8thwall.org/?site_path=pricing), MIT framework without SLAM, SLAM only in the binary (https://8thwall.org/blog/8th-wall-open-source). Not a seven-hour integration. 4. Zappar: no free plan; Developer $12.99/month, non-commercial, 14-day trial "not intended for use in public-facing projects" (https://zap.works/pricing/). ## Build order, real versus faked Hour 0: deploy a skeleton to HTTPS, open it on one iPhone and one Android, confirm camera and `activateAR`. Hours 1 to 2: model-viewer AR with the dhow and Khor Fakkan fort. Hours 2 to 4: Claude guide with the corpus and Web Speech. Hour 4 to 5: image slider. Tomorrow 09:30 to 11:00: MapLibre route between Heart of Sharjah sites and Higgsfield hero video; write the AI Usage Disclosure as you go. Real: AR launch, guide, slider, map, deploy. Faked and labelled: crowd levels (static "typical hours" JSON), authority dashboard (static), reconstructions ("artist's impression"), group tours (cut). Sustainability hook: visitor dispersal to under-visited heritage sites tied to the Heart of Sharjah restoration led by Shurooq (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heart_of_Sharjah).

claims.claim: Safari on iOS has no WebXR support through version 27.2, so any in-browser AR overlay is Android-only; iPhone AR must go through Apple AR Quick Look with a USDZ file.
model-viewer 4.4.0 defaults to ar-modes "webxr scene-viewer quick-look" and generates the iOS USDZ on the fly, so one GLB covers Android WebXR, Scene Viewer, and iOS Quick Look without native code.
getUserMedia only works in secure contexts (HTTPS or localhost); the demo must be deployed to an HTTPS host before any camera feature can be tested on a phone.

Verified CC assets: "Low Poly Ancient Dhow Ship" (CC BY 4.0, 1.6k triangles) and "Khor Fakkan Portuguese Fort, Sharjah" (CC BY-NC, 187.3k triangles); no downloadable falaj, qanat, or barjeel models exist on Sketchfab.

8th Wall's hosted platform and paid plans ended on 28 February 2026; it is now a free engine binary plus MIT framework without SLAM, and Zappar has no free plan (Developer $12.99/month, non-commercial), so neither is a quick hackathon path.

The Anthropic TypeScript SDK runs on Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge, and prompt caching on claude-opus-5-5 needs only a 512-token prefix, so the Sharjah corpus can live in a cached system prompt behind a serverless function with no vector database.
